responses.ask_consent: Before we continue, may I ask you a few questions to see whether you may qualify?
responses.ask_name: Great. May I have your full name?
responses.ask_age: Thank you. How old are you?
responses.ask_part_a: Do you currently have Medicare Part A?
responses.ask_part_b: And do you currently have Medicare Part B?
responses.ask_zip: What is your five digit ZIP code?
responses.clarify_consent: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Is it okay if I ask you a few qualification questions?
responses.clarify_name: Sorry, could you please tell me your first and last name?
responses.clarify_age: Sorry, could you tell me your age in years?
responses.clarify_part_a: Sorry, I need to confirm this. Do you currently have Medicare Part A?
responses.clarify_part_b: Sorry, I need to confirm this. Do you currently have Medicare Part B?
responses.clarify_zip: Sorry, could you repeat your five digit ZIP code, one digit at a time?
responses.qualified: Thank you. I have the information I need.
responses.disqualified: Thank you for your time. Based on the information provided, we are unable to continue with this qualification.
responses.consent_declined: No problem. Thank you for your time.
